q4_plan: Q4 2026: 6-7 sale auctions, PLN 60-90bn; 1-2 switch auctions buying back 2026/27 maturities. October sold ~PLN 38bn (+3.4bn supplementary); November plan PLN 15-26bn; two December auctions (9 & 16 Dec) - supply plan published ~end-Nov.

events.title: US CPI (Oct)
events.note: Global rates driver; Fed December hike priced ~75%.

events.title: PL holiday (Independence Day)
events.note: No settlement; T+2 from 9 Nov = 12 Nov.

events.title: MoF switch auction (settle 16 Nov)
events.note: Buys back WZ1126 / OK0127 / PS0527 / DS0727; sells OK0129, PS1031, NZ0332, DS0436 (+ possibly others). Converts short paper into duration supply.

events.title: PL CPI Oct final (flash 3.5%), GDP Q3 flash, C/A Sep
events.note: Flash already out; GDP consensus ~3.6% y/y.

events.title: MoF sale auction PLN 7-12bn (settle 20 Nov)
events.note: OK0129, PS1031, NZ0332, DS0436 + possibly others. Final offer 2 business days before.

events.title: MoF sale auction PLN 8-14bn (settle 27 Nov)
events.note: Same lines. Coincides with WZ1126 redemption (PLN ~14bn before switch) + WZ coupons (3.96%) -> reinvestment cash.

events.title: WZ1126 redemption + WZ May/Nov coupons
events.note: PLN 14.2bn outstanding before the 12 Nov switch.

events.title: December supply plan due (approx.)
events.note: MoF publishes the next month's plan on the last business days of the month.

events.title: GPWB/TBSP periodic portfolio change
events.note: Month-end extension: taps of OK0129 / PS1031 / DS0436 raise their index units.

events.title: PL CPI Nov flash (approx.)
events.note: CPN fuel programme keeps headline subdued until year-end.

events.title: MPC decision (meeting 1-2 Dec)
events.note: Base case hold at 3.75%; hawks flag Dec/Jan hike. Key swing: government decision on CPN / energy shields for 2027.

events.title: MoF auction (2026 calendar)
events.note: Size per December plan; 2026 needs already financed -> pre-financing 2027.

events.title: GPWB/TBSP periodic change
events.note: DS0727 likely leaves TBSP.Index (~0.57y) -> small extension.

events.title: MPC January meeting (date TBC)
events.note: 2027 schedule not yet published. Market/hawks see January as the likelier hike date.

events.title: OK0127 redemption + PS0130/PS0131 coupons
events.note: OK0127 PLN 15.1bn before switch buybacks; coupons ~PLN 5.3bn -> January reinvestment bid.

events.title: GPWB periodic change - expected 1-3Y / 1-4Y extension
events.note: OK0128 drops below 1Y; PS0130 enters 1-3Y and PS0131 enters 1-4Y (based on observed maturity-window rule).
